title: arabis hirsuta subsp. balansae
intro: Arabis hirsuta subsp. balansae, commonly known as Alpine Rockcress, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the family Brassicaceae. It is known for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to alleviate symptoms of conditions such as arthritis and skin irritations. The therapeutic actions of Arabis hirsuta subsp. balansae include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiseptic actions, which may contribute to its use in treating wounds and infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant are thought to include isothiocyanates and other glucosinolates, which have been shown to have potential health benefits and therapeutic effects.
